commit_definition: Each commit reachable from the pinned default-branch HEAD; includes merges and bots; monthly bins use committer timestamp in Asia/Shanghai. A shared commit in different repos is counted in each repo, including inherited fork history.
creation_definition: GitHub createdAt, deduplicated by repository ID; monthly bins in Asia/Shanghai. This is not the catalog inclusion date.
population: GitHub repositories referenced by catalog entries' primary URL. All entry forms included. Product-only URLs without a primary GitHub URL excluded.
